requirements.text: The rear lamp shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall bear markings that are clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" of the rear lamp's approval marking shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The sequential number of the rear lamp's approval number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: When the rear lamp bears a horizontal arrow in the case of front or rear position lamps or reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, the arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of:

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, the rear lamp shall bear the additional letter "D" to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.quote: (a) The additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps;

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant

requirements.text: Except where the rear lamp has non-replaceable light sources, the rear lamp shall bear a marking indicating: (a) the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed; (b) in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating:

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp has an electronic light source control gear, a variable luminous intensity control, a secondary operating mode, or non-replaceable light sources, the rear lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with:

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) are used, the specific identification code of the module shall comprise the starting letters "MD" for "MODULE" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1.
requirements.quote: This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1.

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) are used, the approval mark on the light source module does not have to be the same as the one on the rear lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant.
requirements.quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant;

requirements.text: The electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control that is part of the rear lamp but not included into the lamp body shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the rear lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the rear lamp emitting the light.
requirements.quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.

requirements.text: The approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the rear lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.quote: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of the rear lamp is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable outer lens and the main body.
requirements.quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.

requirements.text: If the outer lens is used for several devices and bears different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.quote: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
requirements.quote: (a) shall be affixed on the component.

requirements.text: Where the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps of the rear lamp have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed on the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed, the single approval mark may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps of the rear lamp, provided that the conditions of the following sub-paragraphs are met.
requirements.quote: This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that:

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark on the rear lamp shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

requirements.text: When the rear lamp is submitted for approval, the rear lamp shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.quote: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall meet the requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible, the requirements pertinent to the rear lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the rear lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall be designed and constructed so that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which the rear lamp may be subjected in such use, the satisfactory operation of the rear lamp remains assured and the rear lamp retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where the front and rear position lamps are grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated, the rear position lamp may also be used as an end-outline marker lamp.
requirements.quote: Front and rear position lamps which are grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated may also be used as end-outline marker lamps.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, using a common light source and designed to operate permanently with an additional system to regulate the intensity of the light emitted, the rear position lamp and the stop lamp functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either:

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, in either case a note shall be made within the communication document.
requirements.quote: In either case, a note shall be made within the communication document.

requirements.text: Where the applicant requests it, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) of the rear lamp may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components, provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and in addition the following conditions are met.
requirements.quote: On request of the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and in addition the following conditions:

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the applicant shall confirm by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2.) that only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is incorporated.
requirements.quote: This shall be confirmed by the applicant by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.quote: (b) Size: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: The stop lamp and the reversing lamp shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.quote: (d) Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.

requirements.text: In the rear lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.quote: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in the rear lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply:
requirements.quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply:

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in the rear lamp containing more than one light source, the light intensity of the rear lamp shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3, and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or
requirements.quote: (a) The light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, or a stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3, the rear lamp shall automatically fulfil the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category.
requirements.quote: Requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s)

requirements.text: In case a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps, the applicant for type approval of the rear lamp shall declare that the rear lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles; this shall be noted in the communication form.
requirements.quote: In case a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps, the applicant for type approval of the lamp shall declare that the lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles; this shall be noted in the communication form

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the rear lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.quote: (a) The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder of the rear lamp shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
requirements.quote: (b) The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.

requirements.text: The rear lamp, as a light signalling device, shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.1 1Compliance with the requirements for electromagnetic compatibility is relevant to the vehicle type.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) of the rear lamp shall be such that (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s); and (b) it is tamperproof; and (c) regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source; and/or, - any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that

requirements.text: When the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the rear lamp shall meet the photometric requirements of the device.
requirements.quote: (d) when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.

requirements.text: All photometric and colorimetric measurements of the rear lamp shall be made with respect to the following conditions.
requirements.quote: General provisions All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions.

requirements.text: When the rear lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
requirements.quote: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.

requirements.text: When the rear lamp is equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.

requirements.text: When a rear lamp function uses light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.

requirements.text: When photometric measurements of a rear lamp function are made separately for light sources subject to more than one condition, all separate measurement results shall be added together.
requirements.quote: All separate measurement results shall be added together.

requirements.text: Where a rear lamp function uses light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the test laboratory may require from the applicant samples allowing to supply the different light source(s) separately.
requirements.quote: The test laboratory may require from the applicant samples allowing to supply the different light source(s) separately.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one position or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities of the rear lamp shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear lamp's light-signalling functions shall be determined.
requirements.quote: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.

requirements.text: If the rear lamp includes a category 5 or 6 direction indicator, the limits of the light emitting surface of that direction indicator shall be determined.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of category 5 and 6 direction indicators, the limits of the light emitting surface shall be determined.

requirements.text: The requirement to determine the limits of the apparent surface shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps of the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the rear lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) during operation of the rear lamp for testing.
requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp is controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the rear lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant during testing.
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant;

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp is controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the test laboratory may require the electronic light source control gear or the variable intensity control.
requirements.quote: The test laboratory may require the electronic light source control gear or the variable intensity control

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp is not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the rear lamp with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) shall be operated as specified by the applicant (4.8.2.2.1), and the rear lamp with replaceable UN approved light source(s) shall have the light sources operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities (4.8.2.2.2).
requirements.quote: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control: 4.8.2.2.1. in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant; 4.8.2.2.2. in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities;

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp is equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the rear lamp shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.
requirements.quote: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources: 4.8.2.3.1. shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp is equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux, or alternatively the rear lamp may be tested by using one light source in each of the individual lamp holder positions operating at the reference/objective luminous flux and application of the sum of the measured luminous intensities for each direction (4.8.2.3.2).
requirements.quote: The measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux. 4.8.2.3.2. alternatively, may be tested by using one light source in each of the individual lamp holder positions operating at the reference/objective luminous flux and application of the sum of the measured luminous intensities for each direction.

requirements.text: The identification of an electronic light source control gear if applicable or variable intensity control if applicable and/or the voltage applied, including the tolerances, shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1 for the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: The identification of an electronic light source control gear if applicable or variable intensity control if applicable and/or the voltage applied, including the tolerances, shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall comply with the provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity.
requirements.quote: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.

requirements.text: Where the applicant requests an additional test to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, the rear lamp shall show, in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, a maximum intensity of not more than 2.5∙10-1cd.
requirements.quote: In addition, in order to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, the applicant may request an additional test, to show that in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, the maximum intensity is not more than 2.5∙10-1cd.

requirements.text: Where the applicant requests the additional test, the additional test for the rear lamp may be conducted taking into account the influence of the vehicle body.
requirements.quote: This additional test may be conducted taking into account the influence of the vehicle body.

requirements.text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, the rear lamp assembly shall comply with the requirements for: (a) Maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit; (b) Minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.
requirements.quote: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the requirements for:

requirements.text: When all its interdependent lamps are operated together, the interdependent lamp system of the rear lamp shall meet the requirements.
requirements.quote: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.

requirements.text: If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: (a) If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear direction indicator function is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: (b) If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear direction indicator function is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: The variable intensity control of the rear lamp shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities:
requirements.quote: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities:

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities of the rear lamp shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear lamp shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.quote: Colour of light emitted The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics of the rear lamp, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
requirements.quote: To check these colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed in the light emitted by the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: Outside this field no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics of the rear lamp shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
requirements.quote: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.

requirements.text: The test laboratory may require from the applicant samples of the rear lamp allowing to supply the different light source(s) separately.
requirements.quote: The test laboratory may require from the applicant samples allowing to supply the different light source(s) separately.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp shall be permitted a luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.quote: However, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be red.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be red.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity of the reversing lamp may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied.

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, this condition shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and relating documents (see paragraph 3.1.).
requirements.quote: This condition shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and relating documents (see paragraph 3.1.).

requirements.text: Where the type approval for the reversing lamp is granted applying the condition of installation exclusively in a pair, a statement in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1) will inform that the device shall only be installed in a pair.
requirements.quote: Moreover, in the case where the type approval will be granted applying the condition above, a statement in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1) will inform that the device shall only be installed in a pair.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: The colour of light emitted shall be white.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV shall give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities of the rear lamp as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.quote: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the rear lamp light pattern shall be substantially uniform, i.e. the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.quote: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light pattern should be substantially uniform, i.e. the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.

requirements.text: If visual examination of the reversing lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.quote: However, in the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp, stop lamp or rear position lamp (functions) use incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.quote: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp uses light source technology other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.quote: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp uses light source technology other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) after 1 minute; (b) after 10 minutes; and (c) after photometric stability has occurred.
requirements.quote: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV:

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp or stop lamp uses light source technology other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: Where direction indicator lamps are operated for testing, the direction indicator lamps shall be operated in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).
requirements.quote: Operation of direction indicator lamps shall be done in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp or stop lamp uses light source technology other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
requirements.quote: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distributions of the rear lamp at a point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate of the lamp (function) under consideration.
requirements.quote: The luminous intensity distributions at a point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate of the lamp (function) under consideration.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which the rear lamp may be subjected, the rear lamp retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enables the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall be fitted such that it is not possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: When fitted to the vehicle, the reference axis of the rear lamp shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road and parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road; in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.text: In each direction, a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed for the reference axis of the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall be fitted in compliance with any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the rear lamp shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.text: The requirement that lamps constituting a pair have substantially identical photometric characteristics shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.quote: This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

requirements.text: Where the external shape of the vehicle is asymmetrical, the rear lamp shall satisfy the above requirements so far as is possible.
requirements.quote: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the above requirements shall be satisfied so far as is possible.

requirements.text: While the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, the rear lamp shall fulfil all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any.
requirements.quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.

requirements.text: When all other functions with which a lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF, the lamp of the rear lamp shall fulfil the photometric and colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.

requirements.text: When the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, and the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamp are switched ON, each of these other functions of the rear lamp shall fulfil the requirements regarding colour.
requirements.quote: However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamp and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, the rear lamp shall meet the following conditions:
requirements.quote: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, the following conditions shall be met:

requirements.text: Where a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, the single lamp shall be installed in such a way that the following requirement is met:
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that:

requirements.text: Where a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or the requirement of the alternative (b) shall be met.
requirements.quote: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or

requirements.text: Where a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, unless the requirement of the alternative (a) is met.
requirements.quote: (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: Where a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), is composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, the single lamp shall be installed in such a way that the following requirements are met:
requirements.quote: (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that:

requirements.text: Where a single lamp is as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d), the single lamp shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.quote: (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included in the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens, the rear lamp shall not consider these as an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.quote: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: A lamp of the rear lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.quote: However, a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground of the rear lamp shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp of the rear lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, while a lamp of the rear lamp is switched ON, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the lamp shall not be intentionally varied.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp of the rear lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary:

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp of the rear lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall not emit white light that is visible from the rear of the vehicle when the rear lamp is fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.).
requirements.quote: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: To verify paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., for the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp of the rear lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: To verify paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., for the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp of the rear lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: To verify paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., in case of doubt, the rear lamp shall be deemed to fulfil the requirement above if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear lamp shall be such that the rear position lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, the rear lamp shall have all light sources switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp of the rear lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: White 8Also known as white or colourless retro-reflector. 9Nothing in this Regulation shall preclude the Contracting Parties applying this Regulation from allowing the use of white conspicuity markings to the rear in their territories.

requirements.text: The number of lamps of the rear lamp mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp is installed on movable components, the rear lamp shall fulfil the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20.
requirements.quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.

requirements.text: Where the complete interdependent lamp system of the rear lamp is mounted on the moving component(s), the rear lamp shall satisfy the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1.
requirements.quote: (a) Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied.

requirements.text: Where the interdependent lamp system of the rear lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: (b) Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps, where the interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: For direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the rear lamp installed on the movable components shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: When the rear lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the rear lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, the dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps shall show no value of angular inclination, relative to their support, measured after each operation of the movable component, that differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.
requirements.quote: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, this requirement shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.

requirements.text: If the value of 0.15 per cent is exceeded, each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
requirements.quote: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp and the retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If hiding no more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the rear position lamp and the retro-reflector shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or 5.21.2.

requirements.text: If hiding no more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis is not practicable, a remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components, and a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.quote: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components; and A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp is approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., the rear lamp shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement of the light source of the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.

requirements.text: Where the light source module of the rear lamp includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23. above.
requirements.quote: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23. above.

requirements.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of devices of the rear lamp which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) of the rear lamp shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, the means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device of the rear lamp may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.
requirements.quote: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices of the rear lamp which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall have no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the rear lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.

requirements.text: If, when the rear lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the rear lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the rear lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal is reduced to 5º (rear lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit of the rear lamp may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.

requirements.text: When installed on a vehicle, the rear lamp (device) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp is installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and is approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, the rear lamp shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only.
requirements.quote: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: Where the vehicle is of category N2G, N3G, M2G or M3G (off-road), the reversing lamp may be at a maximum height increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.quote: For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.

requirements.text: If installed, the two optional reversing lamp devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle However, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.

requirements.text: Where the two optional reversing lamp devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. are fitted on the side of the vehicle, the vertical aim of the two optional devices may be directed downwards.
requirements.quote: The vertical aim of the two optional devices may be directed downwards.

requirements.text: If the two optional reversing lamp devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. are fitted on the side of the vehicle, the reversing lamp shall comply with the provisions of paragraph 6.4.5.2. above.
requirements.quote: In addition, if the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2., are fitted on the side of the vehicle, the provisions of paragraph 6.4.5.2. above shall apply.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the reversing lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.

requirements.text: If either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible, the reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON.
requirements.quote: It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the two optional reversing lamp devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. shall be such that these devices cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are switched ON.
requirements.quote: Moreover, the electrical connections of the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. shall be such that these devices cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are switched ON.

requirements.text: Where the following conditions are fulfilled, the reversing lamp devices fitted on the side of the vehicle may be switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion of the vehicle up to a maximum speed of 15 km/h:
requirements.quote: The devices fitted on the side of the vehicle may be switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion of the vehicle up to a maximum speed of 15 km/h, provided that the following conditions are fulfilled:

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp devices fitted on the side of the vehicle are switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion of the vehicle up to a maximum speed of 15 km/h, the devices shall be switched ON and OFF manually by a separate control.
requirements.quote: (a) The devices shall be switched ON and OFF manually by a separate control;

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp devices fitted on the side of the vehicle are switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion of the vehicle up to a maximum speed of 15 km/h, the devices may remain ON after reverse gear is disengaged if so switched ON.
requirements.quote: (b) If so switched ON, they may remain ON after reverse gear is disengaged;

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp devices fitted on the side of the vehicle are switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion of the vehicle up to a maximum speed of 15 km/h, the devices shall be automatically switched OFF if the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h, regardless of the position of the separate control, and in this case the devices shall remain switched OFF until deliberately being switched ON again.
requirements.quote: (c) They shall be automatically switched OFF if the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h, regardless of the position of the separate control; in this case they shall remain switched OFF until deliberately being switched ON again.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
